command:
set +e
# Is AMD's different -super5 -threads 1 alignment the chip's ISA dispatch, or the box? A fresh box, then the
# same run with glibc's x86 ISA dispatch narrowed (AVX-512 off; then AVX2/FMA off too). sha256 per run.
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || exit 1
mkdir -p out
uname -m > out/host.txt; grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo >> out/host.txt
run() { lab=$1; t0=$(date +%s); env GLIBC_TUNABLES="$2" muscle -super5 pf01255.25_unaligned.fa -output out/$lab.fa -threads 1 2> out/$lab.log; rc=$?; echo "$lab rc=$rc $(( $(date +%s) - t0 )) s tunables='$2' $(sha256sum out/$lab.fa | cut -c1-16)" | tee -a out/diag.txt; }
run plain ''
run no512 'glibc.cpu.hwcaps=-AVX512F,-AVX512VL,-AVX512BW,-AVX512DQ,-AVX512CD'
run noavx2fma 'glibc.cpu.hwcaps=-AVX512F,-AVX512VL,-AVX512BW,-AVX512DQ,-AVX512CD,-AVX2,-FMA,-FMA4'
cat out/diag.txt
